props.label: Clear beds that stay clear
props.html:
What we do

Clear beds that stay clear

A one-off blitz or ongoing upkeep — we clear weeds from beds, paths and paving, remove the green waste, and can mulch to slow them coming back.

Handy as a standalone job or as part of regular maintenance. Fixed price, no call-out fee.

Get a free quote

What's included

  • Weed clearing from beds, paths and paving
  • Green-waste removal
  • Optional mulch to suppress regrowth
  • One-off or ongoing options
  • Fixed-price quote, no call-out fee

props.label: Weeding FAQs
props.html:
Good to know

Weeding FAQs

Do you offer same day service?
Often, yes, especially for smaller jobs, quotes and urgent tidy-ups. We are open till late, 7 days, 7am to 7pm, so call 0457 897 659 and we will tell you honestly what we can do today.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work. We will also beat any written quote you already have, conditions apply.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor, licence number 353-827-C. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
